issues.problem: The selected official call, section 10, p. 27, requires an implementation report for every work package/event and a milestone for inviting attendees to the EU Survey on Justice, Rights and Values. Neither appears in this supposedly scheme-faithful work-plan contract or the hidden mandatory elements. A proposal can therefore satisfy every supplied instruction while omitting two compulsory implementation components. These are work-plan content, not excluded Part A fields or annex uploads.
